title: The rational-generating-function conjecture below $\kappa$
statement:
Let $\kappa$ denote the threshold for the small permutation classes studied in the paper, and let a permutation class $\mathcal{C}$ have growth rate $\mathrm{gr}(\mathcal{C})$.

**Rational-generating-function conjecture.** Every permutation class with growth rate less than $\kappa$ has a rational generating function.
Classes of growth rate below $2$ are known to have rational generating functions because they cannot contain arbitrarily long alternations; the conjecture asks whether rationality continues throughout the range below $\kappa$.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0712.4006

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2007).
